Dynamic DNS Setup

If you wish to use a DDNS service, you must register for it. The Dynamic DNS client service provider will give you a password or key.

To see the current status of DDNS, click on Show Status.


help
CancelApply Show Status

It is not possible to configure Dynamic DNS due to a feature enabled on your Sky Broadband connection.


If you wish to set up the Dynamic DNS feature please contact Sky Technical Support.

To set up DDNS

  • Select the Use a Dynamic DNS Service check box.
  • Select the name of your dynamic DNS Service Provider.
  • Type the Host Name that your dynamic DNS Service Provider gave you. The DDNS Service Provider may call this the Domain Name.
  • Type the User Name for your DDNS account.
  • Type the Password (or Key) for your DDNS account.
  • Select Apply to use the DDNS service. For security reasons, the Password is to be re-entered when modifying any DDNS account values.

Note: Your Sky Hub supports only basic DDNS and the login and password may not be secure. If you have a private WAN IP address, don't use a DDNS service as it may lead to problems.
